project.title: DND DPDCS SMMS Replacement Project

role_overview.summary: The Department of National Defence's DPDCS division manages critical operational systems supporting Search and Rescue (SAR) coordination across Canada. Christian served as Cloud Architect for Resilient Systems on the SMMS Replacement Project — a high-consequence initiative to replace the legacy SARMASTER software and hardware platform with a modern cloud architecture capable of 24/7 availability, GIS and live data integration, and long-term operational supportability. The engagement required alignment to stringent ITSG-33, DND, and TSB cloud compliance requirements to achieve iATO, and was delivered over a 22-month engagement using Agile methodologies with continuous development cycles.

challenge.summary: DND's DPDCS division operated on the aging SARMASTER platform for national Search and Rescue management — a legacy system that lacked cloud resilience, GIS integration, live-data interface capability, and a credible long-term support path. The replacement initiative required a modern cloud architecture capable of 24/7 availability, real-time data integration, and full compliance with ITSG-33, DND, and TSB cloud security standards to achieve iATO.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: SMMS Search and Rescue Replacement Project

outcomes: Successfully modernized critical Search and Rescue operations system with zero downtime migration to AWS cloud infrastructure
Delivered containerized architecture using Docker/ECS with PostgreSQL, ensuring 24/7 availability for life-saving SAR operations across Canada while meeting stringent DND security requirements
